commands.name: documents.list
commands.description: List the documents in the Draft editor, e.g. "what documents do I have".

commands.name: document.active
commands.description: Say which document is open in the Draft editor, e.g. "which document am I working on".

commands.name: document.open
commands.description: Open a document in the Draft editor by name, e.g. "open my budget document".

commands.name: text.read
commands.description: Read the text of the open document in the Draft editor, e.g. "read my document to me". A long document comes in parts: when truncated is true, call again with from set to next.

from.description: Start position, to read only part. Leave out to start at the beginning

to.description: End position, to read only part. Leave out to read to the end

commands.name: outline.read
commands.description: List the headings of the open document in the Draft editor, e.g. "what are the sections of this document".

commands.name: text.find
commands.description: Find words in the open document in the Draft editor, e.g. "where does this document mention the budget".

caseSensitive.description: True to match capital letters exactly. Leave out to ignore case

commands.name: text.replace
commands.description: Replace words in the open document in the Draft editor, e.g. "change Tuesday to Wednesday in my document". The person may need to accept the change first.

replace.description: The new words. Empty text deletes the words

occurrence.description: Which match to change, counting from 1. Needed when the words appear more than once

caseSensitive.description: True to match capital letters exactly. Leave out to ignore case
